query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017) for engineers
highlights: The paper introduced the Transformer model which relies solely on attention mechanisms without recurrent or convolutional layers [1].
It demonstrated that the Transformer model could achieve state-of-the-art results in machine translation tasks [1].
The work emphasized the importance of self-attention mechanisms in processing sequential data [1].
The paper's findings have been influential in various fields including natural language processing and computer vision [Insufficient evidence [ref]].
